payload.title: botspy scan: mine the adapters into the local store from the CLI
payload.description:
**Intent:** As a BotSpy user, I want `botspy scan` to mine my coding-agent history into the local store from the command line, so that the store at ~/.botspy/store.db stays fresh without writing library code of my own.

Exposes the store's ingest/CDC pass (src/store/ingest.rs) as a CLI verb, per the maintainer's request. Default: all five adapters (claude_code, cursor, codex, grok_bot, antigravity) into the one store at `default_store_path()` ($BOTSPY_HOME/.botspy/store.db). Flags: repeatable `--source` (single adapter or list), `--since` cutoff (ISO date or relative duration like `7d`), `--store` path override, `--dry-run` (report what would change, write nothing), `-o human|json|ndjson` consistent with the other verbs.

**Output:** per-adapter summary — sessions and messages added, updated, unchanged, skipped, plus discovered counts (so an adapter yielding 0 sessions is visible, see bug BOTSPY-81143b — scan must never hide that) — and totals, elapsed time. Exit codes per the CLI convention: 0 ok, 1 unknown source, 2 usage error, 3 store failure.

**Decisions (recorded):**

- The CDC pass behind scan is a refresh-style pass with pruning disabled: pruning would delete stored sessions for any adapter that currently reports 0 (the Codex bug BOTSPY-81143b, or a missing root), so scan adds new and updates changed sessions but never prunes. On an empty store the pass IS the cold ingest the maintainer measured (~44 min); a warm pass is the ~1.7 s incremental refresh.
- `--since` cutoff lands inside the store's ingest/refresh passes as an `IngestOptions` (specs first in features/02_querying), not as CLI filtering.
- Uses the real `crate::store::Store`, not the in-memory `SessionStore` that `build_store` wires.
- Keep src/cli/mod.rs changes minimal and separated: BOTSPY-98386a (store-backed verbs) is also planned against that file.

**Definition of Done:** specs reviewed and red first, then green via `cargo test --test bdd`; cargo fmt/clippy/doc/test gates pass; real run of `botspy scan` and `botspy scan --since 7d --source claude_code` on the maintainer's machine; PR to develop (GitFlow, never main); merged once CI is green; task closed with a comment.
